<![CDATA[ <html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8" /><meta name="generator" content="Aspose.Words for Java 25.9.0" /><title></title><style type="text/css">@font-face { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:bold; src:local('☺'), url('data:application/x-font-woff;base64,') format('woff'); }@font-face { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; src:local('☺'), url('data:application/x-font-woff;base64,') format('woff'); }.awdiv {  }.awspan {   color:#000000; font-size:12pt; }.awimg {  }.awsvg {  }.awpage {  border:solid 1pt black; margin:10pt auto 10pt auto; overflow:hidden; }@media print { body { margin:0pt; padding:0pt; }.awpage { page-break-after:always; margin:0pt; padding:0pt; } }.awtext001 { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; }.awtext002 { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:bold; }</style></head><body><div class="awdiv"><div class="awdiv" style=" "><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">18. </span><span class="awspan awtext002" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">Severability and Assignment: </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">If any provision of this Agreement or part thereof is declared or </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">found to be illegal, unenforceable or void in any respect, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">agree upon a substitute provision that is legal and enforceable and is as nearly as possible consistent </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">with the intentions underlying the original provision. If the remainder of this Agreement is not </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">materially affected by such declaration or finding and is capable of substantial performance, then that </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">term or provision or part thereof shall, to the extent deemed not to form part of this Agreement and the </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">remainder of the Agreement will be enforced to the extent permitted by law. The Receiving Party shall </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">not assign its rights and obligations under this Agreement by operation of law or otherwise without the </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="font-size:11pt;   line-height:11pt;">prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.</span></div></div></body></html> ]]>

<html_content>
<![CDATA[ <html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8" /><meta name="generator" content="Aspose.Words for Java 26.3.0" /><title></title><style type="text/css">@font-face { font-family:'Arial'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; src:local('☺'), url('data:application/x-font-woff;base64,') format('woff'); }.awdiv {  }.awspan {   color:#000000; font-size:12pt; }.awimg {  }.awsvg {  }.awpage {  border:solid 1pt black; margin:10pt auto 10pt auto; overflow:hidden; }@media print { body { margin:0pt; padding:0pt; }.awpage { page-break-after:always; margin:0pt; padding:0pt; } }.awtext001 { font-family:'Arial'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; }</style></head><body><div class="awdiv"><div class="awdiv" style=" "><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">The Parties agree that in the event of any Dispute that is not resolved in the ordinary </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">course of business, Parties shall first use good faith efforts to resolve such Dispute </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">through discussion involving senior executives of both Parties. If such Dispute is not </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">resolved within one (1) month of it being escalated to senior executives, then such </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">matter shall be settled by way of arbitration proceedings under the rules of DIAC as </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">amended from time to time comprising of one arbitrator jointly agreed by the Parties. </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">The arbitration proceedings shall be conducted in accordance with the, any re-</span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">enactments or statutory modifications thereof for the time being in force. The </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">language of the arbitration and the award shall be English and venue shall be at </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;">Dubai. </span><div class="awdiv" ><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:13.41pt;"> </span></div></div></div></body></html> ]]>
</html_content>

<clause display_value="MSA Dispute Resolution Clause">55650b9c48281b10342d1d9357e7fc00</clause>
<document>c9fb9350482c1b10342d1d9357e7fc1c</document>
<html_content>
<![CDATA[ <html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8" /><meta name="generator" content="Aspose.Words for Java 26.3.0" /><title></title><style type="text/css">@font-face { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; src:local('☺'), url('data:application/x-font-woff;base64,') format('woff'); }.awdiv {  }.awspan {   color:#000000; font-size:12pt; }.awimg {  }.awsvg {  }.awpage {  border:solid 1pt black; margin:10pt auto 10pt auto; overflow:hidden; }@media print { body { margin:0pt; padding:0pt; }.awpage { page-break-after:always; margin:0pt; padding:0pt; } }.awtext001 { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; }</style></head><body><div class="awdiv"><div class="awdiv" style=" "><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">The Parties agree that in the event of any Dispute that is not resolved in the ordinary course of </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">business, Parties shall first use good faith efforts to resolve such Dispute through discussion </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">involving senior executives of both Parties. If such Dispute is not resolved within one (1) </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">month of it being escalated to senior executives, then such matter shall be settled by way of </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">arbitration proceedings under the rules of DIAC as amended from time to time comprising of </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">one arbitrator jointly agreed by the Parties. The arbitration proceedings shall be conducted in </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">accordance with the, any re-enactments or statutory modifications thereof for the time being </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">in force. The language of the arbitration and the award shall be English and venue shall be at  </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">Dubai. </span><div class="awdiv" ><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;"> </span></div></div></div></body></html> ]]>
</html_content>

<html_content>
<![CDATA[ <html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8" /><meta name="generator" content="Aspose.Words for Java 26.3.0" /><title></title><style type="text/css">@font-face { font-family:'Arial'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; src:local('☺'), url('data:application/x-font-woff;base64,') format('woff'); }@font-face { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; src:local('☺'), url('data:application/x-font-woff;base64,') format('woff'); }.awdiv {  }.awspan {   color:#000000; font-size:12pt; }.awimg {  }.awsvg {  }.awpage {  border:solid 1pt black; margin:10pt auto 10pt auto; overflow:hidden; }@media print { body { margin:0pt; padding:0pt; }.awpage { page-break-after:always; margin:0pt; padding:0pt; } }.awtext001 { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; }.awtext002 { font-family:'Arial'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; }</style></head><body><div class="awdiv"><div class="awdiv" style=" "><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;"> The Parties agree that in the event of any Dispute that is not resolved in the ordinary course </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">of business, Parties shall first use good faith efforts to resolve such Dispute through discussion </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">involving senior executives of both Parties. If such Dispute is not resolved within one (1) </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">month of it being escalated to senior executives, then such matter shall be settled by way of </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">arbitration proceedings under the rules of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 as amended </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">from time to time comprising of one arbitrator jointly agreed by the Parties. The arbitration </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">proceedings shall be conducted in accordance with the, any re-enactments or statutory </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">modifications thereof for the time being in force. The language of the arbitration and the </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">award shall be English and venue shall be at New Delhi, India. </span><div class="awdiv" ><span class="awspan awtext002" style="  line-height:13.41pt;"> </span></div></div></div></body></html> ]]>
</html_content>

<![CDATA[ <html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8" /><meta name="generator" content="Aspose.Words for Java 26.3.0" /><title></title><style type="text/css">@font-face { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; src:local('☺'), url('data:application/x-font-woff;base64,') format('woff'); }.awdiv {  }.awspan {   color:#000000; font-size:12pt; }.awimg {  }.awsvg {  }.awpage {  border:solid 1pt black; margin:10pt auto 10pt auto; overflow:hidden; }@media print { body { margin:0pt; padding:0pt; }.awpage { page-break-after:always; margin:0pt; padding:0pt; } }.awtext001 { font-family:'FreeSerif'; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; }</style></head><body><div class="awdiv"><div class="awdiv" style=" "><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">The Parties agree that in the event of any Dispute that is not resolved in the ordinary course of </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">business, Parties shall first use good faith efforts to resolve such Dispute through discussion </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">involving senior executives of both Parties. If such Dispute is not resolved within one (1) </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">month of it being escalated to senior executives, then such matter shall be settled by way of </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">arbitration proceedings under the rules of The SIAC Rules as amended from time to time </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">comprising of one arbitrator jointly agreed by the Parties. The arbitration proceedings shall be </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">conducted in accordance with the, any re-enactments or statutory modifications thereof for the </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">time being in force. The language of the arbitration and the award shall be English and venue </span><span class="awspan awtext001" style="  line-height:12pt;">shall be at Singapore. </span></div></div></body></html> ]]>
